top_signals.title: Venezuela Plans to Ship Aluminum to US in Mercuria-Heeney Deal
top_signals.summary: Venezuela is preparing to ship aluminum to the US under a deal with Mercuria Energy Group Ltd. and Heeney Capital, diversifying beyond oil in a quickening revival of commercial ties following years of economic and diplomatic isolation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
